meta.title: Approval Workflow Instance Lifecycle
meta.subtitle: Phase 20 dynamic approval evaluation, multi-step progression, and atomic outcomes

views.label: Creation & Inbox Routing
views.note: Document submission matches definition, freezes snapshots, and queues approvals for active assignees or delegates.

views.label: Step Progression & Supercedence
views.note: Parallel steps supersede peers on first approval; sequential steps advance step_no until complete.

views.label: Terminal & Accounting Outcomes
views.note: Approved triggers GL or target status; rejection or revision releases holds and refunds leave atomically.

cards.title: Versioned Definition & Snapshot Integrity
items: Active workflow definitions match on organization, subject type, and amount threshold [min, max]
Submission freezes both definition configuration and subject payload into immutable JSON snapshots
Subsequent edits to definition steps do not alter currently running workflow instances

cards.title: Segregation of Duties (SoD) & Delegations
items: Requesters are strictly excluded from approval assignees to prevent self-approval deadlocks
Assignees can be explicit users, organizational reporting managers, or privileged roles
Active delegations allow appointed delegates to act during a configured time window without permission leakage

cards.title: Execution Modes & Boundary Transitions
items: Parallel steps execute on first-response, marking remaining peer assignees as superseded
Sequential steps require every ordered step to approve before advancing
Final approval transitions subject status and posts double-entry GL journals (Expense) or refunds deducted balances (Leave rejection)
